notes: Upgrade to 4 Star Hotel: additional RM450/couple

includes: Private Transportation for Day 1 & Day 4 only
Halal Meals (3 International Breakfast, 2 Lunch, Dinner)

itinerary.title: Krabi Island Tour (shared tour)
activities: Visit Railay Beach, Phranang Beach & Phranang Cave
Visit Tub Island, Mor Island and Chicken Island

activities.text: OR Phi Phi Island (add RM100/person, shared tour)
sub: Bamboo Island and visit Maya Bay
Pileh Cove, Viking Cave and Monkey Beach

entries.name: Day 2 Upgrade from 4 Islands tour to 7 Islands Sunset Cruise + Plankton (1pm-8pm)
entries.includes: Yawasom Island, Chicken Island, Tup Island, Mor Island, Sunset Dinner at Poda Island, night snorkeling with bioluminescent plankton at Koh Raeng; Land Transfer & Longtail boat (SIC basis), guide, snorkeling equipment, BBQ dinner

expect.title: Subject to Weather Conditions
expect.body: Heavy rain and thunderstorm may affect island activities.

expect.title: Prepare Cash
expect.body: Prepare cash if you plan to shop or snack, as most places prefer cash.

expect.title: Sharing Transport
expect.body: Sharing transport will be used for all activity transfers.

expect.title: Watch out for Monkeys
expect.body: They can be aggressive. Keep an eye on your belongings.

expect.title: Things Not Mentioned in the Itinerary
expect.body: Must be paid by customers, e.g. add-on activities on-site, toilet.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2 persons per room.
Fare is not applicable during peak seasons; please refer to the peak season surcharge.
Late booking surcharge of RM50/booking will apply for bookings made less than 45 days before the departure date.
This package is valid until the 31st December 2026 travel period.
Private transportation & tour guide is based on 10 hours basis. Additional fees will be charged for every extra hour usage. Payment must be paid in cash.
Quotation, itinerary and price are subject to change accordingly.
Final itinerary and hotel arrangements will be confirmed at least 15 days before the trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity before booking any connecting domestic flights.
Shared tour means the boat and activities are shared with other tourists.

deposit.text: prior to arrival for full payment
